blocks.heading: Look. Do not flip.
blocks.body:
Oxygen can hide experimental switches under Options. A newer DITA version, a per-chapter filter, a draft tool that writes a command for you.

Those switches exist so vendors can test. They are not a work instruction.

A **branch filter** is a filter on one chapter of a booklet, different from the rest. Powerful. Easy to make undebuggable. You can explain it. You do not add it to the only copy of kitepump.

If a draft tool writes a step, you rewrite the command. Confirm shop policy.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: The do-not-enable card.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You enable an experimental switch on kitepump.ditamap and leave it on, or you skip the version number.

Expected: Version recorded. Do-not-enable sentence. Any AI draft rewritten by you, or a not-licensed line.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to The do-not-enable card.
blocks.intro: How to The do-not-enable card. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: The do-not-enable card
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Help > About. Write the Oxygen version in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week8/do-not-enable.txt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Open Options and find DITA or experimental features (verify labels). Write the names you see, or write ‘not present in this version’.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write: I will not turn on an experimental switch on a customer map. I will not add a per-chapter filter (a branch filter) to the only copy of kitepump.ditamap.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: If your copy of Oxygen can draft a step for you, draft one command then rewrite every word yourself. If not, write ‘not licensed :  I still own the command’.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not leave an experimental flag on. Do not save a changed Options set as the shop default.

blocks.q: An experimental switch exists in Options. When do you turn it on for a customer booklet?
options: This afternoon, if a lead asks
You do not. Experimental means the vendor is testing. It is not a work instruction
blocks.why: Look. Write the name. Leave it off. A customer map is not a test bed.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: Oxygen drafts a command for you. The file has no red error. Who owns the step?
options: The draft tool, because the file opens
You. Valid XML can still be the wrong procedure. Rewrite every command you would ship
blocks.why: A clean file can still tell a person to do the wrong thing. You own the words.
